comments.value: Okay so me and KaaneWolf discovered that users that have vrcx running on launch have been having this issue and when we both decided to not have vrcx launched when booting vrchat it fixed the issue. We dont know why or how but wee tested it 10 times without vrcx and 10 times with vrcx and every single time it worked without vrcx launch when you first boot vrchat. This may not be the solution for everyone but it worked for me and Kaane. I hope this helps but it could still absolutely be a bug with steamvr or even vrcx or both.

I have to tell Steam to use the previous version of SteamVR after it force updated to the latest SteamVR last night. It works fine on the previous version. If I leave it on the updated version of SteamVR, the game DOES start and shows the thumbnail for my homeworld, but gets stuck on the "Connecting" screen apparently forever while my GPU pins at 100%. I waited a couple minutes with it stuck in this state before giving up, reverting to the previous version of SteamVR and then it worked fine afterwards.

I Did a whole lot more digging today and launched vrc hundreds of time and narrowed the issues, and concluded its not a VRCX issue. let me explain below.

if you are using the new SteamVR 2.17.4 version the issue happen when vrchat is getting launched in VR mode alongside others steam apps getting launched at the same time.

this is why for me, when VRCX was running in the background it had the auto launch feature in VRCX enabled which launches multiples other apps for me along vrchat at the same time. This launching of multiple apps along VRC will make vrchat hang in the world loading screen when you first launch it.

I tried leaving the auto launch feature of VRCX on and removed all the different apps from the auto launch folder and VRchat launch just fine every single time.

As soon as i add the multiples apps back into the vrcx launch folder, it hangs again. In my case i was trying to run these: vrcvideocacher, vrcfacetracking and babbalonia. (others steam apps getting launched alongside VRC may cause the same issue as well)

Then if all the apps are removed from the auto launch folder of VRCX and I instead manually launch these apps quickly from steam while vrchat is in the process of getting launched at the same time then the same issue happen again which prove that it is not a VRCX issue but instead a issue when one or multiple others steam apps get started/launched at the same time as VRC in VR mode.

if you individually run and start these applications before you launch VRC (for example if you make these apps launch with SteamVR first) then launch VRchat by itself afterward, then the issue does not happen.

TL;DR: To Conclude it seems to be a bug from the new SteamVR 2.17.4 and using the "Previous" branch of SteamVR fix all the issues stated above OR you also have the option to keep SteamVR 2.17.4 and individually run and start your different applications BEFORE you launch VRC (for example if you make these apps launch with SteamVR first) THEN launch VRchat BY ITSELF afterward and the issue should not happen.
